title: Venezuelan Luxuriant Bowl
description: A hearty, comforting bowl filled with the flavors of Venezuela, featuring silky luxuriant chicken and fresh tarragon.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, dried tarragon, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot in bowls, garnished with fresh tarragon if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Venezuelan Luxuriant Bowl!
